- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Location: line 4387 (reuse branch of create_security_pass_fix_issue)
  Issue: The reuse/recovery branch emits only a plain free-text echo ("Security-pass fix issue #N already exists ... reusing it"), while the create branch emits the contractual stable marker SECURITY_PASS_FIX_ISSUE_CREATED. The reuse path is precisely the lost-checkpoint recovery scenario this PR instruments, but it is invisible to the grep-based workflow-log-analysis tooling that audits security-pass behavior via the stable prefix registry.
  Suggested minimal fix: Add one line in the reuse branch emitting a stable-prefixed line, e.g. echo "SECURITY_PASS_FIX_ISSUE_REUSED tracking_issue=${TRACKING_NUM} issue=${issue_number} cycle=$((completed_cycles + 1))", and register the new prefix in the agents.md stable-log-prefix list in the same change (new identifiers are additive, so §6 is honored).
